header_decisions: DEC-16 gates S4-S8 (stored-consent contract: class ceiling read, expiry 30 d default and 90 d max, draft meaning, loop branch, D8 instruction snapshot). S0 writes its ADR as a proposed ledger entry (ADR-0006 in the plan numbering). S0-S3 are not blocked by DEC-16.
DEC-17 (run origin enum, proposed ADR-0012) gates S2; no owner decision beyond the Model Plane owner and the SPACE/QRY acknowledgement.
DEC-13 (D11 service exemption) has no gate: scheduled runs stay pinned to verevon-balance and are never user-selectable (section 2.6 row 19).
DEC-28 (composer compose_authored_instructions for D8) supplies the D8 snapshot that S6 consumes.
Free now, not blocked by a decision: S0, S1, S2 (S2 still needs its DEC-17 acknowledgement), S3.

slices.title: Land-first, ADR, characterise
slices.summary: Records the stored-consent read contract as a proposed ledger entry (ADR-0006 in the plan numbering; the repo has no MP/docs/adr/) that amends the draft-only ruling and rejects a task-runner principal, restates the ZDR waiver clause, updates the authority handoff rows and cross-references plan lines 68 and 457. Docs only; no runtime change.
slices.needs_external: Owner review of the ledger entry and the D1 answer (DEC-16); if the owner rejects D1, S4-S8 park while S1-S3 still ship

slices.title: Persist result and truthful fire status
slices.summary: Adds an idempotent RecordScheduledRunResult RPC that appends the scheduled run's answer to the scheduled thread (non-conversation source scope; ZDR refused) and completes its receipt, and sets cron_fires status, run_id and thread_id on terminal runs, with a fires listing endpoint on capability-core. Behind SESSION_CORE_SCHEDULED_RESULT_PERSIST (default off, which keeps the receipt-only path).
test_commands: cargo test --manifest-path "apps/Model Plane/rust/Cargo.toml" -p session-core -p execution-core scheduled --no-fail-fast

slices.title: Run-level origin
slices.summary: Adds a closed run-origin enum (chat, schedule, trigger, api) in mp-contracts with a Go twin sharing vectors, stamps origin schedule on scheduled runs through the existing immutable metadata binding, defaults user runs to chat, and makes the FE run normalizer read it; old runs read as chat. No migration and no proto change; the thread origin CHECK is untouched.
slices.needs_external: DEC-17 acknowledgement from the Model Plane owner and the SPACE and QRY sessions (ADR-0012)

slices.title: See results
slices.summary: Replaces the permanently disabled See results button in ScheduledRunsPanel with an expander of the last five fires (time, status, outcome, origin chip, withheld count, transcript link), backed by a listScheduleFires client call, a schedule.fires.list action contract, a gateway route and a model-gateway proxy for GET /v1/cron/{id}/fires.
slices.flag: VITE_SCHEDULE_RESULTS (default on once S1 is on; rollback leaves the button disabled)
test_commands: cd "apps/Frontend Plane/verevonv3" && pnpm vitest run src/features/chat/components/ScheduledRunsPanel.test.tsx src/shared/api/cron-client.test.ts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint

slices.title: Consent contract: schema, Control binding, create verification, card
slices.summary: Adds a stored-consent contract to schedule create: a read-only class ceiling and a mandatory expiry (30 d default, 90 d max), signed by Control in its create decision with a digest that capability-core and the gateway recompute and verify against the tool registry, plus a consent card in the dialog. Off unless SCHEDULE_CONTRACT_ENABLED is set; a schedule without a contract stays draft-only.
slices.needs_external: DEC-16 owner ruling on the stored-consent contract (ceiling read, expiry, draft meaning, loop branch, D8 snapshot) and a consent-card comprehension check
slices.flag: SCHEDULE_CONTRACT_ENABLED (capability-core and user-core env, default false; the gateway sends the contract only when true)

slices.title: Carry and re-verify contract at fire and step
slices.summary: Carries the contract JSON, digest and expiry from the workflow template through orchestrator-core, session-core and user-core decisions into execution-core, which recomputes the digest and refuses expired or forged contracts at fire and at each scheduled step. Claims stay at decision version v2 with two serde-default fields, under a mandatory rollout order.
slices.flag: EXECUTION_CORE_SCHEDULED_CONTRACT_REQUIRED (default false; only controls a run created with a contract whose context lacks one)

slices.title: Scheduled Do run in execution-core
slices.summary: Runs a scheduled Do step as a bounded agent loop in a new execution-core scheduled_agent module that offers only contract-approved read-class tools, withholds any other effect visibly instead of pausing for approval, and reports outcome counts through a GetVersion-gated orchestrator branch that calls one activity. Off by default; a schedule without a contract never takes this branch.
slices.needs_external: DEC-16 owner ruling; adversarial security review before enabling the flag in production

slices.title: Off-surface outcome notice
slices.summary: Session-core emits one content-free SCHEDULED_RUN_OUTCOME outbox event when a scheduled run terminalizes; capability-core turns it into one modelplane.scheduled_run_outcome notification to the subject through notification-core (allowlisted in the shared handler map; fail-closed unless the run is non-ZDR), with a deep link to the transcript. Off by default.
slices.needs_external: DEC-38 ruling on the notification type; the owner of the shared notification-core allowlist (also used by Space); the master-matrix row editor
slices.flag: CAPABILITY_CORE_SCHEDULED_NOTIFY_ENABLED (default false; reuses the WS16 native-types switch)

slices.title: Guards: expiry and failure auto-pause, renewal
slices.summary: Adds sweeper guards for schedules that carry a contract: auto-pause on an expired contract (paused_expired) and after three consecutive failed fires (paused_failures), sweep of legacy pending fires older than one hour to unknown, refusal of a bare re-enable of an expired schedule, and a Renew approval path in the panel; each pause emits the S7 outcome.
slices.flag: CRON_CONTRACT_GUARDS_ENABLED (default true once S4 is on; touches only schedules that carry a contract)

slices.title: Owner-bound reads (gated design only)
slices.summary: Design-only, gated slice for owner-bound data-plane reads that would let a scheduled run exceed the 240 s window: a Control model.schedule.data-read decision and an owner-bound bearer for one step. Not scheduled, not sized, and not to start before S6 evidence and the DEC-02 reversal.
slices.needs_external: DEC-02 reversal (owner), an adversarial security review (OD9/D10 gate) and a ledger entry
